title: Model route — deterministic_only
content: A validated rule, workflow state, calculation or database query fully determines the outcome.

structured_data.use_when: A validated rule, workflow state, calculation or database query fully determines the outcome.
structured_data.fallback: Hold if required data is missing; do not call a model to invent the value.

title: Model route — retrieval_plus_small_model
content: Natural language must be mapped to structured fields and the applicable internal knowledge is already available.

structured_data.use_when: Natural language must be mapped to structured fields and the applicable internal knowledge is already available.
structured_data.model: approved low-cost or self-hosted small model
structured_data.fallback: Ask a targeted clarification or route to supervised interpretation.

title: Model route — premium_text_model
content: The text is materially ambiguous, multi-document, conflicting or requires advanced synthesis beyond the approved small-model quality threshold.

structured_data.use_when: The text is materially ambiguous, multi-document, conflicting or requires advanced synthesis beyond the approved small-model quality threshold.
examples: unusual contractual clause analysis for counsel review
structured_data.fallback: Queue, use an alternate approved provider or create a human/specialist task.

title: Model route — multimodal_model
content: The task requires understanding images, drawings, scans or visually structured documents that deterministic extractors cannot handle.

structured_data.use_when: The task requires understanding images, drawings, scans or visually structured documents that deterministic extractors cannot handle.
structured_data.fallback: Request a clearer file, use a specialist tool or human review.

title: Model route — professional_review
content: The output could create binding legal, engineering, tax, medical, security or authority consequences.

structured_data.use_when: The output could create binding legal, engineering, tax, medical, security or authority consequences.
structured_data.model: AI may organise evidence and draft only
